data.name: EndpointInvalid
data.value: An in-process endpoint is an absolute inprocess URL, such as inprocess://local/.

data.name: EndpointRegistered
data.value: The in-process endpoint '{0}' is already registered.

data.name: EndpointMissing
data.value: The in-process platform names the instance's gateway in the {0} variable, which the instance's environment does not set. A gateway that runs the instance in its own process sets it.

data.name: EndpointVariableInvalid
data.value: The {0} variable holds '{1}', which is not an in-process endpoint: an absolute inprocess URL, such as inprocess://local/.

data.name: GatewayUnknown
data.value: No gateway receives at the in-process endpoint '{0}'.

data.name: ClientAlreadyStarted
data.value: The in-process gateway client already carries its gateway's calls to a control plane.
